Rule.name: Report Result POST
Rule.Description:
Retrieves the CSV output of a completed IdentityIQ report and streams it via HTTP POST (raw body, chunked transfer encoding, Bearer auth) to an external URL.
Invocation modes: 1. Task completion rule: attach this rule to the report's TaskDefinition as its completion rule. The completed TaskResult is passed in as the "taskResult" argument. 2. Standalone (Run Rule task / debug page / console): when no taskResult argument is present, the rule looks up the latest completed TaskResult for the report named by the "reportName" entry of the configuration Custom object.
Configuration is read from the Custom object "Report POST Configuration": targetUrl - URL to POST the CSV to (required) bearerToken - Bearer token; store IIQ-encrypted (required) reportName - report TaskDefinition name for standalone lookup connectTimeoutMs - HTTP connect timeout (default 30000) readTimeoutMs - HTTP read timeout (default 300000)
Requirements: - The report must have "Save Report as CSV" enabled so a text/csv PersistedFile is attached to the result. - The file is streamed bucket-by-bucket, so memory use stays flat even for results well over 10 MB.

Argument.name: taskResult
Argument.Description: The completed report TaskResult (present when run as a completion rule).

Argument.name: result
Argument.Description: Human-readable summary of the POST outcome.
